name: Native Decoder Integration & Defender Compatibility
changes: Replaces the shipped NewzDeckYenc.exe subprocess with vendored in-process SABCTools 9.6.3 built for NewzDeck CPython 3.12.10.
Preserves the split NNTP fetch/decode pipeline and keeps the bulk-Python yEnc decoder as an emergency compatibility fallback.
Builds and validates the exact SABCTools 9.6.3 upstream source in the Windows release workflow and records its provenance in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.
Removes NewzDeckYenc.exe from new Portable/Setup payloads and deletes the retired helper during installed upgrades so Defender cannot continue quarantining the old binary.
regression_guards: SABCTools must report exactly version 9.6.3 and successfully decode/CRC-check a synthetic yEnc article in the Windows release job.
NewzDeckYenc.exe is forbidden from the v3.7.1 Portable payload while the installer still terminates/removes a stale helper left by older installations.
The protected NNTP network executor, article cache, async disk pipeline, private SABnzbd 5.1.2 integration, Backup & Restore, Automation sorting, and all twelve themes remain intact.
Release artifacts are produced only from the dedicated trigger commit whose parent is the declared v3.7.1 source commit.
preserved: v3.7.0 production application behavior outside the yEnc decoder implementation and version identity.
Private SABnzbd 5.1.2 engine and Direct Unpack/post-processing ownership.
Newsgroup Browser, Downloads, Smart Import, Automation, Backup & Restore, article-aware library sorting, updater ownership, and all twelve themes.
Existing Windows service, tray, picker, thumbnail helper, and launcher behavior.
